meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 6 — Deeper pass: digital/ICT industry statistics, labour-earnings structure and minimum-wage framework, biodiversity/protected-area statistics, additional structural and social depth. Explicit referenced_by lists for force-layout edge strength.
meta.strategy_note: Continues the deeper mining requested. Digital/ICT tightens the high-tech cluster; earnings/minimum-wage detail strengthens labour dualism edges; protected-area statistics expand the environmental cluster beyond GHG.

candidates.title: Digital / ICT industry and computer & information services statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Digital Affairs / Administration for Digital Industries / DGBAS-related
candidates.description: Statistics on computer programming, information services, digital-industry turnover and related ICT service activity. Complements the semiconductor hardware cluster with the software, systems-integration and digital-transformation layer.
referenced_by: R&D expenditure (business-sector software and systems components)
National accounts services detail and export of ICT services
candidates.notes: Extends the technology cluster from hardware (foundry/OSAT) into software, cloud, AI-related services and digital transformation. Strengthens edges between industrial production, R&D and services trade.

candidates.title: Earnings structure / salary statistics (share below average, industry differentials)
candidates.description: Detailed earnings statistics showing average regular earnings, the share of employees below the mean (recently >70 %), and industry differentials. Electronics and financial services sit well above the mean; education, accommodation/food and other services sit well below.
referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost
Semiconductor and high-tech wage premium analysis
candidates.notes: Deepens the dual-structure labour picture. High semiconductor/electronics earnings versus lower-service and traditional-industry earnings create clear edges into inequality and household-income nodes.

candidates.title: Minimum wage / basic wage framework and adjustments
candidates.description: Statutory minimum (basic) wage level and the periodic adjustment process. Affects a large number of workers and feeds into labour-insurance and pension contribution bases.
referenced_by: Labour insurance and pension contribution tables
candidates.notes: Policy anchor for the lower end of the wage distribution. Recurring citation in labour and social-policy documents.

candidates.title: Protected areas / biodiversity conservation statistics
candidates.publisher: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency / Ministry of Agriculture / Ministry of Environment
candidates.description: Statistics on national parks, nature reserves, wildlife protected areas and overall protected-area coverage (land and marine). Taiwan has designated a substantial share of its territory under various protection categories.
candidates.notes: Expands the environmental cluster beyond climate/GHG into biodiversity and spatial conservation. Useful for regional and land-use edges.

candidates.title: Foreign / migrant worker statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Labor / National Immigration Agency
candidates.description: Statistics on the stock and characteristics of foreign industrial and care workers. Material to labour-supply analysis under ultra-low fertility and rapid ageing.
candidates.notes: Demographic–labour bridge node. Parallel to Korea’s foreign-residents cluster and Japan’s foreign-worker statistics. Strengthens edges between ageing, care and labour supply.

candidates.title: Labor Insurance and Labor Pension statistics
candidates.publisher: Bureau of Labor Insurance / Ministry of Labor
candidates.description: Statistics on Labor Insurance coverage, benefits, and the Labor Pension system (including contribution bases linked to the minimum wage). Central pillars of the social-insurance response to ageing.
candidates.notes: Social-insurance core that links wages, ageing and fiscal sustainability.

candidates.title: National Health Insurance statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on NHI coverage, expenditure, utilisation and financial status. Universal system that interacts closely with ageing and long-term care demand.
candidates.notes: Complements the broader health and long-term care nodes; central to the social-protection cluster.

candidates.title: Science and technology policy white papers / National Science and Technology Council strategic documents
candidates.description: Periodic strategic documents and white papers that set R&D, semiconductor, AI and digital-economy priorities. Recurringly cited in budget, industrial and talent-policy analysis.
candidates.notes: Strategic recurring-citation node that sits above the R&D and semiconductor statistical series.

candidates.title: Detailed price statistics (CPI components, housing-related prices)
candidates.description: More granular CPI component series and housing-related price indicators that complement the headline CPI and PPI.
candidates.notes: Deepens the price cluster and links it more tightly to housing and living-cost edges.

candidates.title: Business demography / establishment and enterprise statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on the number, entry, exit and survival of establishments and enterprises by size and industry. Complements SME and large-enterprise structural views.
referenced_by: Industrial production and employment by firm size
candidates.notes: Structural foundation for firm-size dualism edges.
